title: Introduction — Impact Player Regulation continues
text: The Impact Player Regulation was introduced by the BCCI for the IPL 2023 season and continues for the 2025 to 2027 cycle as confirmed by the IPL Governing Council in September 2024. The rule allows a team to bring in one substitute, the Impact Player, into the playing XI at any point during a match, subject to the conditions described below. Source: TATA IPL Player Regulations 2025-27 announcement (iplt20.com news 4109).

title: Nomination of substitutes
text: Before the toss each captain nominates the playing XI plus five substitute players. Out of those five substitutes, only one may be brought on as the Impact Player during the match. The remaining substitutes may still act as substitute fielders subject to the standard Playing Conditions clause 1.2.

title: When an Impact Player can be introduced
text: Either captain may introduce their Impact Player at a natural break in play. The permitted natural breaks are: the start of an innings, the end of an over, the fall of a wicket, and the moment a batter retires. The Impact Player may be brought on at any point up to but not after the start of the 14th over of an innings.

title: Overseas player restriction
text: An overseas player may only be used as the Impact Player if the starting XI contains fewer than four overseas players. If the starting XI already has four overseas players the Impact Player must be Indian. The incoming overseas Impact Player must also have been one of the five substitutes named at the toss. The IPL has always limited the number of overseas players on the field to four per team and this rule preserves that cap.

title: Status of the replaced player
text: Once an Impact Player has been brought on, the player they replace takes no further part in the match. The replaced player cannot return to the field even as a substitute fielder and cannot be reintroduced as a different role for the remainder of the game.

title: What the Impact Player may do
text: An Impact Player can perform any cricketing role: they can bat, they can bowl up to a full quota of four overs (regardless of how many overs the player they replaced bowled), and they take the field as a regular member of the XI. An Impact Player may not be appointed as captain.

title: Effect on the batting innings — eleven batters cap
text: Only eleven players may bat in an innings. If the Impact Player coming on is a batter who replaces a batter who has already been dismissed or retired, then one of the original XI yet to come in (typically a lower-order player) will not get to bat. The Impact Player does not increase the number of batters available.

title: Match fee parity
text: Under the TATA IPL Player Regulations 2025-27, every playing member of the match — including the Impact Player — earns the standard match fee of INR 7.5 lakh per match in addition to their contracted amount. The Impact Player is treated as a full member of the playing group for fee purposes.

title: Relationship to standard Playing Conditions
text: The Impact Player Regulation sits alongside the IPL Match Playing Conditions (effective 1 March 2026). The Match Playing Conditions do not separately enumerate the Impact Player rule because the regulation is published as part of the TATA IPL Player Regulations 2025-27, a distinct BCCI document. Both must be read together for any tactical or eligibility decision involving substitutions during an IPL match.

title: Sources of authority
text: Authoritative published sources for these rules: TATA IPL Player Regulations 2025-27 (announced via iplt20.com news article 4109, 28 September 2024); supporting explainers on iplt20.com news, ESPNcricinfo (story 1350616, IPL 2023 Impact Player — all you need to know), Wisden, and Olympics.com. The underlying regulation document is published by the BCCI to franchises and not publicly hosted as a PDF on iplt20.com at time of ingest.
